Using \(A=(0,0), B=(s,0), C=(s,s), D=(0,s)\), the trisection points of \(BD\) are
\[
E=\left(\frac{2s}{3},\frac{s}{3}\right),\qquad F=\left(\frac{s}{3},\frac{2s}{3}\right).
\]

Line \(AE\) has slope
\[
\frac{s/3}{2s/3}=\frac12,
\]
so it meets \(BC\) at
\[
G=\left(s,\frac{s}{2}\right).
\]

Line \(GF\) has slope
\[
\frac{s/2-2s/3}{s-s/3}=-\frac14.
\]
At \(x=0\), its \(y\)-intercept is
\[
y=\frac{s}{2}+\frac{s}{4}=\frac{3s}{4},
\]
so
\[
H=\left(0,\frac{3s}{4}\right).
\]

Now
\[
DH=s-\frac{3s}{4}=\frac{s}{4},
\]
and the horizontal distance from \(F\) to \(AD\) is \(\frac{s}{3}\). Thus
\[
[\triangle DHF]=\frac12\cdot \frac{s}{4}\cdot \frac{s}{3}
=\frac{s^2}{24}.
\]
Given this area is \(12\),
\[
\frac{s^2}{24}=12 \implies s^2=288.
\]

\[
\boxed{288}
\]
